name: Huntsman
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]
setup: If the Damsel is not in play, replace one Townsfolk in the bag with the Damsel.
wakes: Each night, including the first, until the ability is used.
interaction: Shakes head or points to a living player. If the Damsel is chosen, the Damsel is woken and shown YOU ARE plus a not-in-play Townsfolk token of the Storyteller's choice.
drunk_or_poisoned: Choosing the Damsel does nothing, but the ability is still spent.

jinxes.text: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added during setup.

rulings.text: If the Damsel is drunk or poisoned but the Huntsman is sober and healthy, the Damsel still becomes a Townsfolk.
Only one Damsel can be in play; the Damsel can be in play without the Huntsman.
Pointing at any player uses the ability (NO ABILITY, night token removed), whether or not it was the Damsel.
The new Townsfolk acts as that character from then on (e.g. becomes the Undertaker and learns who died today).

test_scenarios.name: finds the Damsel
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Huntsman, Bob Damsel, Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk (e.g. Undertaker) and is shown YOU ARE Undertaker; Alice gets NO ABILITY.

test_scenarios.name: wrong pick
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Huntsman, Bob Damsel, Carol General.
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing happens; Alice gets NO ABILITY and is no longer woken.

test_scenarios.name: setup adds Damsel
test_scenarios.setup: 7 players; bag has Huntsman but no Damsel.
test_scenarios.expected: One Townsfolk token is replaced by the Damsel.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Huntsman
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Huntsman, Bob Damsel, Dave Poisoner, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Dave poisons Alice; Alice chooses Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob stays the Damsel; Alice's ability is spent.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Damsel
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Huntsman, Bob Damsel, Dave Poisoner, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Dave poisons Bob; Alice chooses Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob still becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk.
